previous_statement: The polar map referred to by lem-stage1-approximate-group-laws is Pi_delta(U,H)=U bold-dot H on calU x B_delta^{calH}(J), with image S_delta, as referred to by the same polar inverse notation in def-approximate-unitary-space and expanded in the root. An inverse function, when it exists, is unique; denote its component functions (u_delta,h_delta). Thus the u_delta used in 1.4.1 is exactly the first component required at the root, and renaming the external lemma's arbitrary third unitary from W to Z avoids collision with the witness tuple without changing any assertion.
new_statement: The permitted external lem-stage1-approximate-group-laws transfers the C^1 formulas, basepoint identities, and five estimates for the map it denotes by u_delta, and its bound variable W may harmlessly be alpha-renamed Z. It does not, however, identify its phrase 'the polar map' with Pi_delta(U,H)=U bold-dot H on calU x B_delta^{calH}(J), nor assert that this Pi_delta is bijective onto S_delta with a two-component inverse (u_delta,h_delta). The permitted definitions explicitly supply only vocabulary and partial notation. Consequently the unique-inverse clause of the root does not follow from the allowed dependency: a contract such as lem-stage1-polar-retraction, explicitly asserting that Pi_delta is a C^1 diffeomorphism with inverse (u_delta,h_delta), must be added as a dependency (and synchronized with the group-law witness), or the root contract must be weakened.
